scope: Additional full native probe reads per record and noise regime, beyond common boundary features; outcome evaluation and audits accounted separately.

models.features: Shared B11: current response, historical schedule and signed/unsigned transfer features
Shared B11 plus success fraction of eight direct reads of the protected original packet
Shared B11 plus success fraction after 32 writer reads and 32 fresh successor reads

shared_costs: All models receive the same B11, task knowledge and historical information. Boundary acquisition, transfer computation, model fitting/scaling and prediction arithmetic are not free; these are excluded from the additional-native-probe column and must be described separately.
limitations: 64/8 is an eightfold ratio of native probe-read counts, not a measured eightfold wall-time or total-cost ratio.
Marginal model-specific wall times were not separately measured; batching and shared inputs prevent assigning the joint runtime by simple division.
Cached reuse saves new compute but does not remove the original measurement cost.
